analysis_type: Post-hoc sensitivity analysis on an already inspected test set; not a new blind test or preregistered study
only_scientific_change: Core serving-state input only; primary RAN outputs, roles and training/selection recipe unchanged.

retention_rule.floor_mask: Existing C.2 mask derived from all six original CSV RSS values at simulator floor
retention_rule.association: Last earlier non-floor association in the same vehicle retained chronological stream, including observations before the window
retention_rule.preserved: Supplied speed and causal speed difference, legacy componentwise direction fill and timer clipping

reuse.Core_full_seed42: Existing C.2 hold checkpoint and scaler, frozen before this sensitivity run
reuse.RAN: Original corresponding-seed OOF, full-training validation and test positions/variances; unchanged
reuse.source_data: Same source reports, targets, vehicle roles and folds; no additional data

split_contract.fold_preprocessing: Held-out fold excluded from scaler fitting and checkpoint selection; original internal development split used

neural_recipe.architecture: Exact primary Core15 BiLSTM and position/log-variance heads
neural_recipe.loss: Exact primary GaussianNLL implementation, coordinate system and clamp
neural_recipe.scaler: StandardScaler over clean fit windows/time steps, reused in clean and augmented phases
neural_recipe.augmentation: Primary observation recipe unchanged; Core feature inputs unchanged by radio augmentation
neural_recipe.checkpoint_rule: All strict validation-NLL improvements eligible; clean-validation NLL for clean phase
neural_recipe.optimizer_and_schedule: Exact primary AdamW, learning rates, cosine schedule, batch size, seeds, shuffling and clipping; source-hash bound

gb_rule.selection: Strict minimum model-selection validation MSE, using full-training domain outputs
gb_rule.training_inputs: Original RAN OOF + retention Core OOF; same vehicle/window IDs
